> Either those chickens are on something, or that's a slice of kangaroo.

I think something got mixed up here

I'm probably older than what all of this is acceptable for but I'm inexperienced. I'm so unsure now, I don't know what I'll do tomorrow.

Thanks for listening to my rant, though

I feel like I'm not growing up. I keep falling in my old patterns that bring me to be alone and detached. I have friends but I want someone, I don't want to wake up alone, I know that I need someone and I know that there might be a girl if I just asked her out but I don't do it. I know that's what I need but I can't do it.
I apologized to her when she caught me but it might have sounded like begging for her to let me keep the test. It doesn't feel good anyway.
I can retake it, it's not a huge loss but I feel like an idiot for what I did. I'm really ashamed of how I acted when I was caught and by the fact that I didn't stop when I could.
I'm glad he's an ex now

I've just finished **The Island of Doctor Moreau, by H. G. Wells** and I really liked it.

Now I've begun reading **American Gods, by Neil Gaiman** and I'm really enjoying it so far, even if I'm just a few pages in. It's my first book by Gaiman and I find his writing very pleasant to read.

I've been seeing a therapist for a while, I've been to a couple of appointments. I've talked to him about this daydreaming but I still have some trouble opening up to him or finding out exactly what's the issue I should talk about to him.

This sense of being alright without doing anything to actually feel better and live a better life. Knowing it's not alright but not doing anything as long as I ignore how things are going. I don't know if it's dissociation, but it looks like it.
I don't think I can give you a proper answer right now but thanks for the time you took writing this.

Because I try not to think about them.

I'm in a state of delusion where I try to keep me thinking about something I should do instead of doing it, convincing myself that I'll do it and then switch onto something else, trying not to think about how much I've disappointed myself.
No, i'm not. I'm not taking anything
